svg.title: Turret wiring diagram
svg.desc: Webcam and Arduino Uno connect to a laptop by USB. Uno pins D2 to D5 drive the pan ULN2003 driver and D6 to D9 drive the tilt driver. A 9V supply feeds an MB102 module set to 5V, which powers both drivers. All grounds are joined, including the Uno GND. Each driver connects to a 28BYJ-48 motor.
svg.text: Dots = joined, plain crossings = not joined
